entries.name: DLC Merger
entries.author: Argent77
entries.summary: Merges the Siege of Dragonspear DLC into the main game directory so mods can access and modify its content. Required before installing any SoD-touching mods.

entries.name: EE Fixpack
entries.author: Camdawg, Luke, argent77, DavidW
entries.summary: Community-driven fix compilation that corrects hundreds of bugs the official patches missed in BG1EE, SoD, BG2EE, and ToB. Still in beta but widely recommended.

entries.name: BG1 Unfinished Business
entries.author: icelus, devSin, SimDing0, Idobek, Ascension64, CamDawg, SixOfSpades, Dudley
entries.summary: Restores 35 pieces of cut BG1 content. 16 components work on BGEE/EET; 19 are blocked (already fixed in Enhanced Edition). Covers quests, NPCs, dialogues, items, creatures, and areas.

entries.name: Tenya Thermidor
entries.author: Coutelier
entries.summary: Adds young Tenya from Baldur's Gate as a joinable cleric NPC companion with water-based abilities, unique dialogue, and a personal quest involving the Bowl of Water Elemental Control.

entries.name: Sirene NPC
entries.author: Artemius_I
entries.summary: Adds Sirene, a tiefling paladin, as a joinable NPC in BG1 with full voice acting, banters, a personal quest, and romance option.

entries.name: Drake NPC
entries.author: Artemius_I
entries.summary: Adds Drake, a human fighter, as a joinable NPC in BG1/SoD with dialogue, banters, and a personal storyline.

entries.name: Verr'Sza
entries.author: Lava Del'Vortel
entries.summary: Adds Verr'Sza, a rakshasa bounty hunter, as a joinable NPC in BG1. An evil-aligned companion with unique dialogue.

entries.name: White
entries.author: Lava Del'Vortel
entries.summary: Joinable chaotic neutral human barbarian NPC for BG2 with banters for all BioWare NPCs and romance options for male protagonists.

entries.name: Baldur's Gate: Enhanced Edition Trilogy
entries.author: K4thos
entries.summary: Merges BG1:EE, SoD, BG2:EE, and ToB into a single continuous game so you play one character from Candlekeep to the Throne of Bhaal without restarting.

entries.name: Revert Pathfinding
entries.author: Bubb
entries.summary: Reverts the Enhanced Edition pathfinding algorithm to the original BG2 behavior. Fixes issues where characters take bizarre routes around obstacles.

entries.name: Lefreut's Enhanced UI (BG1EE skin)
entries.author: Lefreut
entries.summary: Replaces the default UI with a cleaner, more functional interface using the classic BG1 visual style. Adds widescreen journal, inventory, and map improvements.

entries.name: Lefreut's Enhanced UI (SoD skin)
entries.author: Lefreut
entries.summary: Replaces the default UI with a cleaner, more functional interface using the Siege of Dragonspear visual style. Same functional improvements as the BG1EE skin.

entries.name: Lefreut's Enhanced UI (BG2EE skin)
entries.author: Lefreut
entries.summary: Replaces the default UI with a cleaner, more functional interface using the BG2 visual style. Same functional improvements as the other LeUI skins.

entries.name: Infinity UI
entries.author: Renegade0
entries.summary: Modular UI overhaul with individually selectable improvements to inventory, spell book, character sheet, and other screens. More customizable than LeUI.

entries.name: EE UI Tweaks
entries.author: AncientCowboy, Lefreut
entries.summary: Collection of 58 individual UI tweaks you can pick and choose from: hidden tooltip options, dialog tweaks, inventory changes, and quality-of-life improvements.

entries.name: Portrait Gender Separator
entries.author: Dan_P
entries.summary: Sorts portrait files into gendered subfolders so the character creation portrait picker only shows portraits matching your chosen gender.

entries.name: EEex
entries.author: Bubb
entries.summary: Engine extension that unlocks modding capabilities beyond what the base EE engine allows. Required by several advanced mods (Bubb's Spell Menu, some kit mods).

entries.name: Bubb's Spell Menu Extended
entries.author: Bubb
entries.summary: Adds a searchable, sortable spell menu for easier spell selection during gameplay. Requires EEex.

entries.name: Auto Loot
entries.author: Bubb
entries.summary: Automatically loots containers and fallen enemies, saving you from tedious clicking. Configurable filters for what to pick up.

entries.name: Infinity Innovations: Key Names
entries.author: btigi
entries.summary: iiKeyNames is a mod for Baldur's Gate 2, which alters the names of key items once they have been used, to help you organise your inventory and only carry required items around.

entries.name: BG:EE Classic Movies
entries.author: Sam
entries.summary: This is a WeiDU mod that restores the 'classic' movies from the original Baldur's Gate and select movies from Baldur's Gate II to BGEE/SoD/EET.  There is a new component that restores the vanilla BG1 chapter and dream screens to BGEE/SoD/EET (using the appropriate theme).

entries.name: Baldur's Gate Graphics Overhaul
entries.author: Yovaneth, White Agnus
entries.summary: AI-upscaled area backgrounds and character sprites that sharpen the game's visuals at higher resolutions. Large download but purely cosmetic.

entries.name: Druid Grove Makeover
entries.author: Ulb
entries.summary: Druid Grove Makeover mod for BG2 / BG2EE / EET

entries.name: Sentrizeal Animation Pack
entries.author: Sentrizeal
entries.summary: Provides replacement character avatar animations and fixes missing animation sets for various classes and races across the Baldur's Gate and Icewind Dale games.

entries.name: Jaheira Recast
entries.author: AstroBryGuy
entries.summary: Restores Jaheira's planned SoD voice acting, reconnecting cut voiced dialogue lines and giving her an updated soundset, with options for BG1+BG2 sounds and her BG2 portrait.

entries.name: Made in Heaven: Fixes & Restorations
entries.author: AngelGryph
entries.summary: Fixes and restores cut content across both BG1 and BG2 in one package. Includes creature corrections, dialogue restorations, and item fixes.

entries.name: Sareveff Fix
entries.author: Tresset
entries.summary: Fixes Sarevok's Deathbringer Assault ability in Throne of Bhaal, correcting damage application to lower-level creatures, laugh timing, and adding feedback when he stuns enemies.

entries.name: Rebalanced Poison Weapon
entries.author: Tresset
entries.summary: Rebalances the Poison Weapon ability for Blackguards and Assassins by scaling damage based on character level, making it viable throughout the entire game.

entries.name: Animal Companions
entries.author: Ulb
entries.summary: Gives ranger and druid animal companions that level up with you, similar to the NWN system. A permanent pet that fights alongside the party.

entries.name: Endless BG1 Mod
entries.author: jastey
entries.summary: Adds events and encounters to the BG1 post-Sarevok period, letting you continue exploring the Sword Coast after the final battle instead of immediately jumping to SoD.

entries.name: Another Fine Hell
entries.author: jastey
entries.summary: Adds a planar quest involving Baatezu and Tanar'ri politics. Visit a slice of the Nine Hells with new areas and fiendish encounters.

entries.name: Jastey's Tweaks
entries.author: jastey
entries.summary: Collection of 17 SoD and EET transition tweaks: dialogue fixes, continuity patches, and quality-of-life improvements for the BG1-to-SoD-to-BG2 journey.

entries.name: The Boareskyr Bridge Scene
entries.author: jastey
entries.summary: Expands the Boareskyr Bridge scene in SoD with additional dialogue options, NPC reactions, and role-playing choices for that pivotal story moment.

entries.name: Imoen 4 Ever
entries.author: jastey
entries.summary: Keeps Imoen as an active party member throughout SoD and into BG2, with new dialogue. Prevents the story from forcibly removing her.

entries.name: The Calling
entries.author: CamDawg
entries.summary: Major BG1 quest chain with new areas and encounters. INSTALL ISSUE: Components 0 and 20 fail via mod_installer (AUTO_TRA bug). Component 40 (Exotic Items) works. Manual install or PI recommended.

entries.name: Bonus Pack in Baldur's Gate
entries.author: subtledoctor
entries.summary: Brings Baldur's Gate 2 Bonus Pack content into BG1. Adds the bonus merchant and items from the original BG2 bonus CD.

entries.name: Reflections of Destiny
entries.author: subtledoctor
entries.summary: Major plot restructuring mod spanning BG1/SoD/BG2. Reshuffles content, rewrites Caelar backstory, adds SoD areas to BG2. Beta v0.9

entries.name: Baldur's Gate Mini Quests and Encounters Modification
entries.author: jastey
entries.summary: Adds 17 small quests and encounters scattered across BG1 areas. Each is bite-sized (15-30 min) and integrates with existing locations.

entries.name: Ascalon's Questpack
entries.author: Ascalon, WhiteAgnus, jastey
entries.summary: Adds 13 new side quests to BG1 with branching outcomes. Includes investigation quests, moral dilemmas, and dungeon crawls across the Sword Coast.

entries.name: Extra Enhanced Expanded Encounters!
entries.author: GraionDilach
entries.summary: Adds 8 new random encounters and expanded existing ones across BG1 wilderness areas. Makes traveling between areas less predictable.

entries.name: Shades of the Sword Coast
entries.author: Lava Del'Vortel
entries.summary: Large BG1 quest mod adding new areas, quests, and encounters south of Baldur's Gate. Includes a new storyline involving the Shades and a dungeon complex.

entries.name: Brage's Redemption
entries.author: jastey
entries.summary: Expands Brage's redemption quest in BG1 with additional dialogue, encounters, and consequences for your choices about the cursed knight.

entries.name: The BG1NPC Project
entries.author: Blucher, Kish, Andyr, Domi, cmorgan, AstroBryGuy
entries.summary: Massively expands companion dialogue, banter, and romance options for all original BG1 NPCs. Adds hundreds of new conversations and inter-party interactions.

entries.name: BG1 NPC Music
entries.author: Blucher, Kish, Andyr, Domi, cmorgan,
entries.summary: As we were unable to get the original character voice actors to voice all the new lines, we instead sought out music appropriate to each NPC to be played whenever they initiate banter. This musical package is a separate, optional package.

entries.name: Ajantis BG1 Expansion Modification
entries.author: jastey
entries.summary: Expands Ajantis's BG1 story with additional dialogue, a deeper romance, and character development beyond his vanilla content.

entries.name: Coran's BG Extended Friendship Talks
entries.author: Domi
entries.summary: This mod expands Coran's Friendship talk sequence, adding up to eighteen (18) new banters with the protagonist (and one potential comment by Garrick) for a player character who is not in an active romance with him. If you have The BG1 NPC Project installed, they begin playing after the last regular friendship talk. If the player started and interrupted Coran's The BG1 NPC Project romance, the friendship sequence should initiate after that. If you do not have The BG1 NPC Project installed, they become available immediately.

entries.name: Xan's Friendship Path
entries.author: Kulyok
entries.summary: This mod provides a friendship path for Xan NPC in Baldur's Gate I.

entries.name: The Vanishing of Skie Silvershield
entries.author: Lava Del'Vortel
entries.summary: BG1/SoD quest mod exploring what happened to Skie Silvershield. Adds a mystery storyline with investigation and multiple resolutions.

entries.name: Aerie in BG:EE
entries.author: Coutelier
entries.summary: Aerie in BG:EE

entries.name: Made in Heaven: Meta-Mod
entries.author: AngelGryph
entries.summary: Made in Heaven meta-mod for BG1: auto-configures recommended component selections for the Made in Heaven mod family.

entries.name: Baldur's Gate Romantic Encounters Modification (BG1RE)
entries.author: Berelinde, jastey, Kulyok, Lava Del'Vortel, Thimblerig, Twani
entries.summary: Adds 49 optional romantic and social encounter vignettes throughout BG1. Each is a short scene (flirting, tavern events, chance meetings) that adds flavor.

entries.name: Balduran's Seatower
entries.author: jastey
entries.summary: Quest mod that adds a new district and lots of quests to the city of Badur's Gate!

entries.name: The Lure of the Sirine's Call
entries.author: Ghreyfain, jastey
entries.summary: BG1 quest mod adding a new coastal area with a storyline involving sirines. About 2-3 hours of content with new maps, items, and encounters.

entries.name: Candlekeep Revisited
entries.author: The Artisan
entries.summary: Lets you return to Candlekeep as a visitor during BG1, with new dialogues and interactions reflecting your journey since leaving.

entries.name: Gorgon
entries.author: TotalMilk90
entries.summary: A mod for BG:EE that adds a thieves guild into the town of Beregost.

entries.name: Blackhearts
entries.author: AWizardDidIt
entries.summary: Quest mod adding two major questlines: 'The Huntress' (BG1) featuring Illasera as a bounty-hunting quest-giver, and 'Pilgrimage' (SoD) uncovering Sarevok's legacy, with new areas, items, and dialogue.

entries.name: Loretakers
entries.author: Acifer, Lava Del'Vortel
entries.summary: Quest mod adding a new 2-level dungeon beneath Baldur's Gate city with fresh areas, enemies, and quests for approximately 1-2 hours of gameplay.

entries.name: Unfinished Business
entries.author: Andyr, Cliffette, Barren, Icelus, Ghreyfain, SimDing0, DawidW, Nythrun, Kulyok; Angel Gryph
entries.summary: Restores 24 pieces of cut BG2/ToB content: quests, dialogues, encounters, and items that Bioware left unfinished or removed before shipping.

entries.name: Almateria's Restoration Project
entries.author: Almateria
entries.summary: Restores 12 additional pieces of cut BG2 content not covered by Unfinished Business. Includes restored items, encounters, and quest threads.

entries.name: Quest Pack
entries.author: SimDing0, Wisp
entries.summary: Adds 15 new quests to BG2: additional stronghold scenarios, encounter expansions, and new quest lines. Each is self-contained and well-integrated.

entries.name: Hidden Adventures
entries.author: Lumorous, White Agnus, jastey
entries.summary: Adds 10 hidden quest chains to BG2 that trigger naturally through exploration. New dungeons, NPCs, and storylines woven into existing areas.

entries.name: Restored Rhynn Lanthorn
entries.author: DavidW
entries.summary: This is a small mod that restores the original extended quest for the Rhynn Lanthorn, which was present in the beta version of Baldur's Gate II but was cut before release. Almost all the files are still in the game, so that it can be restored very faithfully.

entries.name: Adalon's Blood
entries.author: jastey
entries.summary: Short quest extention for Baldur's Gate II.

entries.name: Alternatives
entries.author: Berelinde, jastey
entries.summary: Adds alternative solutions to key BG2 plot points, letting you resolve major quests in new ways you couldn't before.

entries.name: Expanded Thief Stronghold
entries.author: Gebhard Blucher
entries.summary: Expands the thief stronghold questline in BG2 with additional missions, NPCs, and a longer storyline for Shadow Thief leaders.

entries.name: Adventures in Papperland
entries.author: CBisson
entries.summary: This mod adds a few amusing dialogs with 4 musicians named "The Beatles".

entries.name: Lucy the Wyvern
entries.author: Berelinde; Gwendolyne
entries.summary: Adds Lucy, a baby wyvern companion, as a pseudo-NPC pet in BG2. She grows throughout the game and helps in combat.

entries.name: The Minotaur and Lilacor
entries.author: Yovaneth
entries.summary: This mod adds a small backstory to the minotaur who reveals just what he and the three dead bodies are doing in Athkatla's sewers.

entries.name: Alcool
entries.author: Mathrim Cauthon
entries.summary: Adds a humorous interaction between party members at the end of BG2 Chapter 3 when agreeing to go to Spellhold, triggered when Korgan is in the party.

entries.name: Every Mod and Dog
entries.author: Cliffette, CamDawg
entries.summary: Adds a selection of small diversions and optional sidequests to Baldur's Gate II, aiming to recapture the lighter, more adventurous spirit of the original Baldur's Gate.

entries.name: CoM Encounters
entries.author: Dark Raven, Magnus Thorenson, CoM Solaufein
entries.summary: Adds new encounters and improvements to BG2, including improved Druid Grove druids, Underdark drow encounters, and an enhanced Shagbag encounter.

entries.name: Fishing for Trouble
entries.author: Yovaneth; abg1
entries.summary: BG2 quest mod adding a fishing-themed adventure. A light-hearted side quest with new areas and characters.

entries.name: Tower of Deception
entries.author: Valiant; Lava Del'Vortel
entries.summary: BG2 dungeon mod adding a deceptive tower with puzzles, traps, and illusion-themed challenges. A few hours of dungeon-crawling content.

entries.name: Test Your Mettle!
entries.author: Argent77
entries.summary: BG2 combat challenge mod with 6 arena-style encounters that test your tactical skills. Includes unique rewards for completing challenges.

entries.name: Assassinations
entries.author: Kulyok, jastey
entries.summary: BG2 quest mod about assassination contracts. Short quest chain with stealth-oriented encounters.

entries.name: The Sellswords
entries.author: Kulyok; jastey
entries.summary: BG2 quest mod following a group of sellswords. Adds a mercenary storyline with new characters and combat encounters.

entries.name: Back to Brynnlaw
entries.author: Kulyok, jastey
entries.summary: Adds a quest to return to Brynnlaw Island in BG2 after the main Spellhold storyline, with new content and encounters there.

entries.name: Dungeon Crawl
entries.author: Kulyok, Kayless, WoRm, jastey
entries.summary: BG2 dungeon-crawl mod adding an extended underground adventure with multiple levels, traps, and boss encounters.

entries.name: Fading Promises
entries.author: Berelinde; jastey
entries.summary: BG2 quest mod with a storyline about broken promises and their consequences. Dialogue-heavy with moral choices.

entries.name: Derat's Ogre
entries.author: Deratiseur
entries.summary: Tiny quest

entries.name: Romantic Encounters
entries.author: Kulyok, Ajnos, berelinde, Catseye, cmorgan, Domi, Evaine Dian, gertjanvh, jastey, magrat, Western Paladin, Aeryn, Cal Jones, Thimblerig
entries.summary: Adds 54 optional romantic and social encounter scenes throughout BG2. Short vignettes adding flavor: tavern flirtations, chance meetings, and intimate moments.

entries.name: Colours of Infinity: Tales of the Deep Gardens
entries.author: Lava Del'Vortel
entries.summary: Standalone BG2 quest adding a new explorable garden area with encounters, puzzles, and a self-contained storyline. Part of the Colours of Infinity series.

entries.name: Colours of Infinity: Innershade
entries.author: Lava Del'Vortel
entries.summary: BG2 quest mod adding the town of Innershade with quests, shops, and NPCs. A fully developed new settlement to explore. Part of the Colours of Infinity series.

entries.name: Colours of Infinity: The White Queen
entries.author: Lava Del'Vortel
entries.summary: BG2 quest mod with an arctic-themed quest chain involving the White Queen. New areas and encounters in a frozen setting. Part of the Colours of Infinity series.

entries.name: Colours of Infinity: I Shall Never Forget
entries.author: Lava Del'Vortel
entries.summary: Short BG2 story mod focused on memory and loss. Dialogue-driven with atmospheric storytelling. Part of the Colours of Infinity series.

entries.name: Eilistraee's Song
entries.author: Lava Del'Vortel
entries.summary: BG2 quest mod about Eilistraee, the drow goddess of dance. Adds a storyline exploring drow culture beyond Underdark evil.

entries.name: Athkatlan Grounds: Southern Edge
entries.author: Lava Del'Vortel
entries.summary: New Athkatlan district available from the start of BG2, featuring a main quest, mini-quests, shops, a tavern, and a temple.

entries.name: Athkatlan Grounds: The Ooze's Lounge
entries.author: Lava Del'Vortel
entries.summary: Adds a new section of Athkatlan sewers with three areas to explore, mini-quests, new items, and unique graphics.

entries.name: Athkatlan Grounds: The Tangled Oak Isle
entries.author: Lava Del'Vortel
entries.summary: New Athkatlan area where players help restore peace to a community on the Tangled Oak Isle, once an independent village absorbed by the city.

entries.name: Athkatlan Grounds: Bridge's Block
entries.author: Lava Del'Vortel
entries.summary: Adds two new interior areas to the Bridge District with four quests, new characters, items, and spells to discover.

entries.name: Athkatlan Grounds: Alabaster Sands
entries.author: Lava Del'Vortel
entries.summary: Small quest mod adding Athkatla's public beach area with seven new quests, fresh characters, items, and item graphics.

entries.name: The Journey to the Whin Hill
entries.author: Lava Del'Vortel
entries.summary: IWD-style adventure for BG2 where players search for a man in the Whin Hill area, facing wyverns and uncovering the mystery behind a dangerous settlement.

entries.name: The Dreadful Tales: In Love, Undeath
entries.author: Lava Del'Vortel
entries.summary: Quests centered around the Temple of Evening Glory, a deity of love, beauty, and undeath, with a new companion and optional romance.

entries.name: The Dreadful Tales: The Bloodied Stings of Barovia
entries.author: Lava Del'Vortel
entries.summary: Dark Ravenloft-themed adventure transporting players to Barovia, featuring gothic horror encounters, undead creatures, and intricate puzzles.

entries.name: The Dreadful Tales: Juniper and the Stone Leech
entries.author: Lava Del'Vortel
entries.summary: ToB companion and quest mod set in the Ravenloft realm of Har'Akir, featuring a dark temple investigation with optional romance for female protagonists.

entries.name: Tidings
entries.author: acifer
entries.summary: A quest mod for Baldur's Gate II that starts in the Docks District of Athkatla and introduces new areas, enemies, and items for parties around levels 9-12.

entries.name: Call of the Lost Goddess
entries.author: Acifer
entries.summary: Major quest mod adding 46 new areas, a new city district (Goldspires), 40+ unique items, and 8-10 hours of gameplay. Inspired by "For Duty and Deity".

entries.name: Fowl Wish
entries.author: Glittergear
entries.summary: Short quest mod involving a noble estate, a mage apprentice, chickens, and a candle of limited wish, with a unique chicken familiar companion as reward.

entries.name: Gone Nuts
entries.author: Glittergear
entries.summary: GoneNuts, a BG2EE quest

entries.name: Dead Gardens
entries.author: Glittergear
entries.summary: DeadGardens, a BG2EE quest

entries.name: Errant Justice
entries.author: Glittergear
entries.summary: UNSUPPORTED: Author has hidden the GitHub repo and is not supporting this mod. A replacement mod, Blood and Faith, is in development for BG1. The mod still works but has known unfixed issues.

entries.name: Neverwinter Nights for Baldur's Gate
entries.author: abalabokhin
entries.summary: Recreates the full Neverwinter Nights campaign within BG2/EET. Triggered at 1.35M XP with new areas, spells, and quests. Does NOT require the original NWN game. Campaign-locking once entered.

entries.name: Ascension
entries.author: David Gaider, Westley Weimar; Shawne, Cuv, JediMindTrix, White Agnus, Turambar, Miloch, ALIEN, agb1, DawidW
entries.summary: Restores and expands the Throne of Bhaal finale with David Gaider's original vision: smarter Melissan, expanded Balthazar options, deeper Bhaalspawn interactions, and tougher final battles.

entries.name: Turnabout
entries.author: Jason Compton
entries.summary: Lets you play as the villain in ToB's final act. After the normal ending, switch perspectives for an alternate climax with new tactical challenges.

entries.name: The Longer Road
entries.author: ladydorotea
entries.summary: Expands Irenicus's storyline into ToB, offering a quest to resurrect and redeem (or re-destroy) him. Adds several hours of new content with moral weight.

entries.name: Wheels of Prophecy
entries.author: DavidW
entries.summary: Overhauls how ToB's prophecy storyline unfolds, giving you more control over the Bhaalspawn plot. Changes the pacing and choices in Chapters 9-10.

entries.name: Fix Wheels of Prophecy
entries.author: Crevsdaak
entries.summary: Compatibility fix for Wheels of Prophecy. Install this after Wheels to resolve any scripting conflicts with other mods.

entries.name: Gavin NPC
entries.author: berelinde
entries.summary: Adds Gavin, a morninglord cleric, as a joinable BG1 NPC with a sweet romance, healing focus, and thoughtful dialogue.

entries.name: Fight the Heavens
entries.author: morpheus562
entries.summary: ToB quest mod about challenging the divine order. Adds an alternative endgame path with celestial-themed encounters.

entries.name: The Reunion
entries.author: Kulyok; jastey
entries.summary: ToB quest mod about reuniting with characters from your past. Adds emotional closure scenes and encounters.

entries.name: The Slithering Menace
entries.author: vilkacis
entries.summary: This mod adds a small "quest" containing "an encounter of serpentine nature" on the pocket plane dimension, as well as a brand new (and stylish!) item.

entries.name: Artisans Caravans
entries.author: The Artisan
entries.summary: Adds Caravan Masters who transport the party to named locations at half the normal travel time for a gold fee, reducing tedious overworld travel across the Sword Coast.

entries.name: Achievements!
entries.author: Argent77
entries.summary: Adds an achievement system tracking your accomplishments across the game. Unlockable achievements for quest completions, discoveries, and milestones.

entries.name: Slayer Revisions
entries.author: semiticgoddess
entries.summary: Overhauls the Bhaalspawn Slayer transformation with new abilities, visual effects, and progression. Makes the Slayer form a viable tactical choice rather than a liability.

entries.name: Golem Construction for Spellcasters
entries.author: Argent77
entries.summary: Lets spellcasters research and build custom golems as permanent companions. Adds crafting quests, materials gathering, and 10 golem types from flesh to adamantine.

entries.name: Indira NPC
entries.author: Erg
entries.summary: Adds Indira, a half-elf fighter/mage, as a joinable NPC in BG1 with personal quests and banters.

entries.name: Valerie NPC for BG
entries.author: Kaeloree
entries.summary: Adds Valerie as a joinable NPC companion in Baldur's Gate, a new character with her own personality, dialogue, and storyline.

entries.name: Isra NPC for BG
entries.author: Rhaella
entries.summary: Adds Isra, a cavalier paladin, as a joinable NPC in BG1 with thoughtful dialogue, banters, and a romance for male PCs.

entries.name: Glam NPC Pack
entries.author: Glam Vrock
entries.summary: Adds five new joinable NPCs to BGEE (a halfling archer, drow assassin, dwarven defender, priest of Talos, and dragon disciple), each with friendship tracks, personal quests, and inter-party dialogue.

entries.name: Zakrion
entries.author: jmaeq
entries.summary: Adds Zakrion, a human Duelist NPC to BGEE, found near a ship wreckage on the Sword Coast, with custom portraits, voicing, a friendship track, and a semi-romance path.

entries.name: Bristlelick BG1EE NPC
entries.author: Lava Del'Vortel
entries.summary: Adds Bristlelick, a unique NPC, as a joinable companion in BG1.

entries.name: Walahnan
entries.author: Lava Del'Vortel
entries.summary: Recruitable chronomancer NPC suffering from germophobia, found at Ulgoth's Beard, with content for both BG1EE and Siege of Dragonspear.

entries.name: Emily
entries.author: Skitia
entries.summary: Adds Emily as a joinable NPC in BG1 with dialogue and character development.

entries.name: Kale
entries.author: Skitia
entries.summary: Adds Kale as a joinable NPC in BG1 with dialogue and personal storyline.

entries.name: Helga
entries.author: Skitia
entries.summary: Helga's NPC Mod data for BG1

entries.name: Recorder
entries.author: Skitia
entries.summary: Adds Recorder, a lore-keeping NPC, as a joinable companion with extensive dialogue, commentary on locations, and a personal quest.

entries.name: Vienxay
entries.author: Skitia
entries.summary: NPC Mod for Baldur's Gate

entries.name: Kvel
entries.author: The Artisan
entries.summary: Adds K'Vel, a drow Fighter/Mage/Thief companion recruitable in Chapter 5 of Baldur's Gate: Enhanced Edition, featuring unique dialogues and crossmod banters.

entries.name: Solaufein's Rescue
entries.author: jastey
entries.summary: Transforms Solaufein into a recruitable NPC companion for Baldur's Gate II by adding a quest to rescue him from the drider chambers before he can join the party.

entries.name: Alora NPC
entries.author: Raven, gwendolynefreddy
entries.summary: Expands Alora with new dialogue and interactions beyond her brief vanilla BG1 appearance.

entries.name: Sir Ajantis NPC
entries.author: jastey
entries.summary: Continues Ajantis's story into BG2/ToB as a joinable NPC with new quests, romance continuation, and extensive dialogue.

entries.name: Coran NPC
entries.author: Domi

entries.author: Shohy
